findings.consequence: The flow omits storage-connection or download-lock release failures after successful completion or a skip. The implementation retains the completed or skipped status and records a release warning, so readers cannot infer that a terminal success or skip may carry this warning.
findings.correction: Document that connection or lock release can fail after completion or skip, retaining the terminal status and recording a warning.

evidence: src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:765-812 implements download and publication retry limits, interruption, and worker cleanup.

src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:861-864, 930-940 and 1013-1016 set skipped or completed status; lines 1056-1085 clean temporary files and close storage. An OSError from storage.close appends a warning but preserves completed or skipped status unless cancellation, a failed attempt, or pause applies.
src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:990-1016 and 1193-1204 allow a shutdown pause to take precedence after publication succeeds.
src/uav_downloader/daemon/download_files.py:62-115 and src/uav_downloader/daemon/nas.py:252-313 implement publication, ownership tracking, upload retries, and cancellation cleanup.
tests/test_daemon_downloads.py:318-416 and 1350-1478 cover close failures, download and publication retries, cancellation, and pause; tests/test_nas.py covers upload retry.
